headline: Binance Took In 475.7 Million Dollars In 24 Hours As OKX Shed 586.1 Million
narrative: Binance clean assets rose 475.7 million dollars over 24 hours, while OKX clean assets fell 586.1 million dollars. The figure is the change in dollars held on each venue excluding the exchange's own token, so the Binance rise means that money arrived and the OKX drop means that money left. Bitfinex took in 138.1 million dollars over the same window, and the net change across exchanges was a 61.0 million dollar outflow.
author: jordan
